---
title: "Healthy Habits"
---

## Healthy habits for Classes 1–12

The same core message can be taught at different levels: **use technology responsibly, sleep well, move daily, study with focus and develop real-world skills.**

<div class="card-grid">
<div class="card green">
<img class="habit-img" src="images/outdoor_play.svg">
<h3>🏃 Move every day</h3>
<p><b>Classes 1–5:</b> Play outside every day.</p>
<p><b>Classes 6–8:</b> Balance screen time with outdoor activity.</p>
<p><b>Classes 9–12:</b> Protect time for exercise, sports or walking.</p>
</div>

<div class="card violet">
<img class="habit-img" src="images/healthy_sleep.svg">
<h3>😴 Protect sleep</h3>
<p>Keep screens away during bedtime and create a calm night routine.</p>
</div>

<div class="card blue">
<img class="habit-img" src="images/focused_study.svg">
<h3>📚 Study with focus</h3>
<p>Reduce unnecessary notifications and distractions while studying.</p>
</div>

<div class="card orange">
<img class="habit-img" src="images/hobbies.svg">
<h3>🎵 Build life skills</h3>
<p>Encourage music, dance, art, sports, reading, creativity and practical skills.</p>
</div>
</div>

## Simple child message

> **Use technology → Play → Study → Talk → Sleep**

Technology should support childhood, not replace sleep, movement, relationships and learning.
